query: Last weekend I went hiking out at Maple Ridge and found the most perfect patch of wild blackberries, I picked almost a full pound and made a tiny batch of jam that turned out way better than any store-bought one I’ve ever tried. I also finally got around to fixing the wobbly leg on my kitchen table last night, used a couple of leftover wood shims from when I put up my bookshelf and now it doesn’t rock at all even when I lean on it. Oh, and I adopted a little tabby kitten earlier this week, she’s already figured out how to open the cabinet where I keep her treats, it’s equal parts cute and annoying. I actually reached out because my APN settings seem to be broken, and also my SIM card is locked with a PIN so I can’t get my mobile data or calls to work right now.
